title: Actionable Review Findings and Quality Evidence
summary: Decision dossier for an evidence-first Quality Studio finding contract: exact highlighted source spans, typed evidence and reproducibility, requested and executed model attribution, independent human assessment and resolution, a scoped repository-owned ignore policy, immutable terminal run history, and a conservative bridge to the delivered TE-38 per-model review-quality evidence receiver. Recommends five approval-ready slices and keeps observational precision distinct from recall or causal model quality.
